analysis.summary: Akiko Global Services Limited held its Q1 FY27 earnings conference call, reporting healthy revenue and profitability growth driven by core business expansion and new branch contributions. Management expressed strong confidence in achieving its revised FY27 revenue guidance of INR325 crores to INR350 crores and maintaining a PAT margin of 9% to 11%. The digital platform AkikoPay has completed its development and launched on Android and iOS stores, with insurance and mutual fund integrations slated for the upcoming quarter. Additionally, the company is restructuring upper management by hiring key personnel including a CEO to separate strategic vision from execution. Akiko Global Services Limited reported robust financial and operational performance for Q1 FY27, driven by its expanding credit card sourcing and lending distribution businesses.

guidance.claim: Management revised the FY27 revenue guidance to INR325 crores to INR350 crores.
guidance.quote: Earlier, I had given a target of INR300 crores. Now I am revising this guidance. I am very comfortable to get INR325 crores to INR350 crores this FY27.

guidance.claim: Management expects PAT margins to be between 9% and 11% for the year.
guidance.quote: Sir, I am confident of 9% to 11% for this year.

guidance.claim: The company targets a 3-year CAGR of 70% to 100% year-on-year.
guidance.quote: Because my vision is very clear for the next 3 years that our CAGR will remain the same at 70% to 100% year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability.
guidance.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

guidance.claim: Management expects 70% to 100% revenue growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: I would like to give an outlook for FY27, which approximately I am expecting a target of 70% to 100% revenue growth, we have taken a minimum.

guidance.claim: Management targets INR 1,000 crores revenue by 2030 and PAT margins of 12% to 13%.
guidance.quote: And we have also taken a long-term vision of 2030. We have a proper clear vision that we build INR1,000 crores revenue by 2030 and take PAT margins further to 12% to 13%.

guidance.claim: Management expects AkikoPay revenue of INR 50 crores to INR 100 crores in FY27.
guidance.quote: If seen, I am expecting AkikoPay revenue of INR50 crores to INR100 crores in FY27.

guidance.claim: Management expects Q1 revenue to be around INR 65 crores.
guidance.quote: I am expecting INR65 crores to something in between crores in Q1.

guidance.claim: Management targets an unsecured book of INR 1,000 crores by the end of FY27.
guidance.quote: By FY27, my target is INR1,000 crores of unsecured book.

guidance.claim: Management guides for an outlook of INR 300 crores for FY27.
guidance.quote: Otherwise, I am expecting my outlook for 2027 is INR300 crores. That is not going below INR300 crores, this is going to be above INR300 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: The sourcing pipeline is healthy, providing good visibility for upcoming quarters.
demand_outlook.quote: Bank partnerships are strong, and the sourcing pipeline is healthy, due to which we see good visibility for the upcoming quarters as well.

demand_outlook.claim: Personal loans are currently growing the fastest among all loan products.
Credit card penetration remains relatively low at approximately 7-8% of the population, offering significant headroom for expansion.
demand_outlook.quote: Credit card penetration remains relatively low at ~7-8% of the population, indicating significant headroom for expansion compared to global benchmarks.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes that digital demand lead generation is complemented by a strong physical servicing network.
demand_outlook.quote: Digital lead generation is important, but a strong physical servicing network improves both conversion and customer experience.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes physical presence improves lead conversion rates from 10% to between 60% and 80%.
demand_outlook.quote: Where our digital conversion rate is 10%, with physical presence, that conversion reaches 60% to 80%, which we have felt over the last two years.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observes that banks are more aggressive in March for financial product sales and cool down in April.
demand_outlook.quote: Because every bank's balance sheet has closed in March and after closing aggressively, they are a little cool down in the first month of starting the New Financial Year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management states that 10% to 12% of people are doing KYC for the 2 lakh limit while others prefer the 10,000 limit.
demand_outlook.quote: See, I am seeing that only 10% to 12% people are doing KYC for 2 lakh limit. They are more interested in 10,000 limit.

capex_expansion.claim: The company currently has 25 branches across 19 cities in India.
capex_expansion.quote: So, we have 25 branches across 19 cities in India.

capex_expansion.claim: New branches are planned for Indore and Kerala over the next 2-3 months.
capex_expansion.quote: Over the next 2-3 months, a couple of more branches are lined up, with one opening in Indore and one towards Kerala.

capex_expansion.claim: The company maintains a total plan of 25 branches for the year.
capex_expansion.quote: There is a plan for 25 branches in total.

capex_expansion.claim: Management expanded company-owned branch presence across multiple cities including Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bangalore, and others.
capex_expansion.quote: Along with this, we have also expanded our company-owned branch presence in multiple cities. Like Delhi NCR is known to everyone, Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Pune, Jaipur, Chandigarh, Lucknow, Kolkata, Patna, and many emerging markets.

capex_expansion.claim: Management has increased branch count from 3 or 4 in the last quarter to 16 branches across India.
capex_expansion.quote: I mean, where we had three or four branches in the last quarter, today we have 16 branches across India.

margins_costs.claim: In unsecured loans, the average payout is 3.10%.
margins_costs.quote: In unsecured, our average payout itself is 3.10%.

margins_costs.claim: The company maintains a disciplined cost structure with controlled operating burn on AkikoPay.
margins_costs.quote: Disciplined cost structure with controlled operating burn

margins_costs.claim: Margin pressure in Q4 was due to planned investments in branch expansion, technology infrastructure, and AkikoPay scale-up.
margins_costs.quote: This was due to our planned investment towards branch expansion, this was the most important thing, in which some of our money has been spent on that. Some of our money has been spent in technology infrastructure, on the AkikoPay scale-up initiative.

margins_costs.claim: Margin pressure also arose from Dubai operations due to the geopolitical situation around the Iran region.
margins_costs.quote: And some of our margin pressure has come in Dubai operations, there has been temporary margin pressure due to the current geopolitical situation, as you all know, around the Iran region.

margins_costs.claim: Management states customer acquisition cost on AkikoPay is negligible and significantly lower than competitors.
margins_costs.quote: Where Paytm, PhonePe or CRED spends around INR250 to acquire a customer, there our cost comes to INR10 to INR15.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's employee count stands at 950, consisting of 16 tech staff, 700 sales executives, 50 backend staff, and management.
orders_capacity.quote: Sure. Absolutely. Look, currently on the tech side, we have a total of 16 people -- 16 people on the tech side. On the sales side, we have odd 700 people. On the backend side, we have odd 50 people. And the rest are our management staff.

orders_capacity.claim: Partnerships have been built with 40+ banks and NBFCs, including 20 to 25 new partnerships this year.
orders_capacity.quote: And we have built partnerships with 40+ banks and NBFCs, in which 20 to 25 new partnerships have been built this year.

orders_capacity.claim: The loan business monthly disbursement run rate has reached INR 400 crores+, amounting to an annual book of INR 5,000 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, we have reached a monthly disbursement run rate of INR400 crores+, which if we count annually, our book has become INR5,000 crores as of today.

orders_capacity.claim: Combined workforce including employees and channel partners has crossed 900+.
orders_capacity.quote: Reflecting this scale-up, our total combined workforce, including employees and channel partners, has now crossed 900+, which is a very strong growth compared to last year.

orders_capacity.claim: Total employee count stands at 489 and channel partners on the ground at 400.
orders_capacity.quote: Last, we had given 326, I guess. So, from 326 to 489 odd our employees have become and the 100 our channel partners have become 400 on ground.

capital_allocation.claim: There are no plans for fundraising for the next 6 months to 1 year.
capital_allocation.quote: So, no need for any fundraising for the next 6 months or 1 year. That means there is no plan until then.

risks_headwinds.claim: The Dubai business faced revenue pressure during the first quarter due to war.
risks_headwinds.quote: In Dubai, due to war, our total revenue for the entire quarter was INR1.25 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties, and assumptions that are difficult to predict.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward-looking statements are not guarantees of future performance and are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.

management_commitments.claim: The iOS version of AkikoPay will be updated on Apple's App Store within a week.
management_commitments.quote: Customers are also really liking our new Android version and this same version will be implemented on Apple's App Store within a week.

management_commitments.claim: Integration of insurance and mutual funds into AkikoPay will begin and take 2 months.
management_commitments.quote: After that version, our integration of insurance and mutual funds will begin. That will take 2 months.

management_commitments.claim: Upper management and CEO positions will be filled over the next 2 to 3 months.
management_commitments.quote: Over the next 2 months -- 3 months, as you mentioned, those positions will be filled.

management_commitments.claim: Receivable days are expected to come down to within 90 days in Q2.
management_commitments.quote: In Q2, I see receivable days coming down to within 90 days.

management_commitments.claim: Monthly loan disbursements are targeted to reach INR1,000 crores by December end.
management_commitments.quote: plus by December end, we will reach around INR1,000 crores disbursement.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability.
management_commitments.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

management_commitments.claim: The iOS version of AkikoPay is progressing as planned and is expected to offer a similar comprehensive experience in the coming months.
management_commitments.quote: The iOS version is progressing as planned and is expected to offer a similar comprehensive experience in the coming months.

management_commitments.claim: Management commits that AkikoPay will be live on iOS with all features within this month.
management_commitments.quote: So most likely within this month, AkikoPay will be live on iOS with all features.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to launch mutual funds and insurance by August.
management_commitments.quote: So mutual fund and insurance going to be live by August onwards because for that I have applied for some IRDAI license.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
